notation.sigma: v2(Q), equal to 0 for opposite-parity a,b and 1 for both odd a,b
notation.A_B_residues: AE gives A mod8,B mod8 in {1,7}
notation.mu: 2^g*mu0 with mu0 odd and g=(delta+e+f) mod2

mixed_parity_u_v.condition: exactly one of u,v is a 2-adic unit

primitive_source_Q2_cases.exhaustive_relative_to_AE: these are the only primitive parity cases compatible with the two coupled conics

generic_two_term_Q2_square_rule.form: F=a^{-1}*(x^2-2^g*mu0*y^2), where a=A*B mod8 is 1 or 7 and x,y have odd unit parts

square_term_dominates_E1_less_E2.h_at_least_3: F is a Q2-square iff a=1 mod8
square_term_dominates_E1_less_E2.h_equal_1: F is a Q2-square iff a=7 mod8 and mu0=1 mod4

negative_mu_term_dominates_E1_greater_E2.g_equal_0_h_equal_2: F is a Q2-square iff mu0=3*a mod8
negative_mu_term_dominates_E1_greater_E2.g_equal_0_h_at_least_4: F is a Q2-square iff mu0=-a mod8

tie_E1_equal_E2.normalized_ratio: z=x0/y0 is odd and z^2!=mu0 on the retained nonzero square open
tie_E1_equal_E2.criterion: F is a Q2-square iff n is even and w0=a mod8

generic_two_term_Q2_square_rule.completeness: necessary and sufficient by the Q2 square criterion: even valuation and odd unit congruent to 1 mod8

AB_residue_filter.statement: every full receiver branch must have A=B mod8, equivalently A*B=1 mod8
AB_residue_filter.proof_mixed: if A!=B and e=f=0, both extra roots are square-term-leading with gap delta+2-2*sigma>=3, so division by A*B leaves leading unit 7 mod8
AB_residue_filter.proof_both_units: if A!=B, e=1 and the minus extra root is square-term-leading with gap delta+1+beta-2*sigma>=5, again leaving leading unit 7 mod8

critical_deep_branch_filter.Delta: delta+3-2*sigma-alpha, the second-minus-term exponent minus the first-minus-term exponent
critical_deep_branch_filter.statement: under the critical condition the branch has no Q2 full-cover point: allowed Delta values are 1,-1,-3,...; Delta=1 fails the gap-1 rule for a=1, while every negative Delta has g=1 and hence odd output valuation

remaining_same_AB_taxonomy.mixed_e0_f0: both extra roots are Q2-automatic at the full-cover layer because A*B=1 and their square-leading gaps are at least 3
remaining_same_AB_taxonomy.deep_f1_plus_root: the plus extra root is Q2-automatic; its square-leading gap is delta+1+alpha-2*sigma>=5

deep_f1_minus_root.Delta_0: g=0 tie; use the generic n-even and w0=1 mod8 criterion

remaining_same_AB_taxonomy.no_additional_point_independent_filter_c: outside the two branch-only filters above, survival can depend on alpha and/or the normalized tie unit; no branch existence is asserted

AY_specialization_check.substitution: A=B=1, f=1, mu0=1, g=0, e=(1+delta) mod2
AY_specialization_check.BI_recovered: Delta>=4 automatic, Delta=2 impossible, Delta<0 impossible
AY_specialization_check.BJ_recovered: Delta=0 is exactly the z^2-1 equality branch and the generic tie criterion specializes to the BJ Q2 unit criterion

exact_fixed_p_diagnostics.interpretation: the prime-2 branch-only rows are nonredundant with AE and the BU Q row, but the two certified parameters retain outer branches
